data.case_title: Electricity price increase from Stadtwerke Musterstadt
data.title: Stadtwerke Musterstadt: electricity price adjustment effective 1 November 2026
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH is raising the unit price and base fee for Sam Rivera's MusterStrom Flex electricity tariff from 1 November 2026, increasing estimated yearly costs from €577.08 to €647.28 (+€70.20/year); the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €48.00 to €54.00 starting 15 November 2026. A special right to cancel without notice applies under § 41(5) EnWG.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is increasing both the per-kWh price and the monthly base fee, which raises your yearly cost by about €70. Because of this price change, German law (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) gives you a special right to cancel the contract without the usual notice period, effective at the same time the new price takes effect. You don't have to act if you want to keep the contract - the higher advance payment will be collected automatically. If you'd rather switch providers, the app will show you the deadline by which your cancellation must arrive at Stadtwerke Musterstadt. No other action is required.
